name: resistance band jump lunge with single arm row
description: A jumping lunge combined with a one-arm band row. It raises your heart rate and builds leg power.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.
